# Tessa Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old in Volume 5  <sub>[v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c7 P4](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Hollowmere, Glen St. Agnes  <sub>[v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Tessa is a plump, rotund little girl with curly red hair and hazel eyes that she crinkles tightly shut when falling asleep. She has a round face with dimples.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c3 P16](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0016), [v5 c4 P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007)_

## Personality

Tessa is a proud and somewhat prim young girl who takes great delight in her finest dresses, shoes, and hats. She obeys instructions dutifully and is determined to carry out tasks assigned to her, though she is easily frightened by unexpected or scary threats.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015)_

## Traits

- Prim and proud of her fine clothing  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000)</sub>
- Obedient to household rules and tasks  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005)</sub>
- Easily frightened by threats and aggressive behavior  <sub>[v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To faithfully deliver gift baskets and fulfill tasks assigned to her by Tabitha  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005)</sub>

## History

Tessa Carrow is born at Hollowmere, Glen St. Agnes, as the youngest child of Nell Harcourt and Dr. Hugh Carrow. She spends three months in Brierley with her siblings while her parents travel in Europe, returning to Hollowmere in the spring. One afternoon, Tabitha sends her to the manse to deliver a basket of early strawberries directly to Mr. Ashdown or Aunt Martha. At the manse gate, Mary Stubbs corners her, trying to seize the basket, and performs a wild, intimidating dance to scare her. When Tessa refuses to hand over the basket, Mary chases her down the street waving a large dried codfish. Terrified, Tessa trips into a mud puddle, ruining her fine dress, hat, and slippers, and spilling the strawberries. Miss Winifred rescues the crying girl and carries her back to Hollowmere, where Tabitha cleans and comforts her.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005), [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P4](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0004), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005), [v5 c7 P13](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0013), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 c7 P18](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0018)_
